Callout.Name: Courier Intercept
Callout.Message: Courier believed to be carrying evidence out of the city.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect on foot, bag over the shoulder.

Script.Line: I am going to the station. What is wrong with the station?
The bag is mine. It came off a courier van.
You cannot look in the bag. You need to tell me why.

Lines.Briefing: The bag is the evidence. The person is secondary.
Lines.Approach: They are walking for the station with a bag they did not have this morning. Do not lose sight of the bag.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
